name: test_agent_plan_resolve
description: Validate a coding agent's last-resort test-command proposal against the strictest layer of verification.py's precedence, gated behind allowAgentTestPlan.

repoPath.description: Absolute path to the git repository the agent's proposal is validated against.

testMode.description: 'targeted' requires every changed test-like file to be covered by some proposal; 'full' relaxes that coverage requirement. Defaults to 'targeted'.

changedPaths.description: Repository-relative paths changed by the candidate, used to reject claimed coverage of paths outside the diff and (outside full mode) to require every changed test file be covered.

proposal.description: The agent's proposed test commands. Required and must be a non-empty array; each item is validated against detected build systems, real files, and claimed coverage.

argv.description: Proposed command argv; its entrypoint must belong to a build system this repository has evidence of, and every path-like token must name a real file.

coveredPaths.description: Changed paths this command claims to cover; any path outside changedPaths is rejected.

repairRoots.description: Write-scope roots this command implies for a later repair step.

affectedUnit.description: The build/test unit this command targets; defaults to the argv entrypoint when omitted.

verificationState.description: 'discovered' when the agent's proposal was accepted, 'blocked' when it failed validation.

executionOutcome.description: Fine-grained outcome; 'configuration_blocked' is a documented VerificationBlocked reason, 'infra_blocked' is an unexpected validation error.

candidates.description: Accepted, validated agent-proposed commands. Empty when blocked.

scope.description: 'repository' in full mode, otherwise 'focused' or 'affected' depending on whether coverage was claimed.

affectedUnit.description: The build/test unit this command targets.

coveredPaths.description: Changed paths this command claims to cover.

repairRoots.description: Union of repairRoots across all accepted candidates. Empty when blocked.

affectedUnits.description: Present only when accepted: affectedUnit of each accepted candidate.

reason.description: Present only when blocked: the VerificationBlocked message or the infrastructure error text.
